title: Now what do i do.....
author: ShadowBreakGames
selftext: I made this game with AI, I don't know how to code so it took care of that side for me,  I also got AI to build me a program in which I could import part of characters and instantly have them rigged and ready to go, this made making animations for everything so much faster and easier, at the end of the trailer you can see a little bit of that process, the thing is, now what do I do with it?

comments.author: KingofKingsofKingsof
comments.body:
